headline: Purchase loans sink
to a *2012 low*
slides.fig_caption: Home purchase loans in Q3 2026, the fewest for any third quarter since 2012
slides.sub: Down 9% from the spring quarter and 12% from a year earlier.

slides.title: Q3 2026 vs. Q3 2025, *every lane is down*
slides.note: Total lending came to *$498.1 billion*. Freddie Mac's 30-year rate rose from 6.43% in early July to 7.28% by early October.

slides.label: of Q3 loans were *purchases*, up from 54.5% a year earlier
slides.body: Refinances fell harder, down 16% in a quarter to 561,290, the fewest since Q2 2024. The average purchase loan rose 3% to $411,756.

slides.title: Big metros where purchase loans *grew*
slides.note: Quarter-over-quarter change, metros over 1 million people. Purchase lending fell in *73.6% of metros* analyzed.

slides.title: Fewer buyers, *each one counts*
slides.body: With purchase lending this thin, every pre-approved buyer is worth real follow-up. Stay close to your lender partners, and keep past clients warm for when rates finally ease.
